findings.field: Schedule 2 — Description of shares of stock
findings.now: Schedules 2 and 3 stop at ten rows, and there is no control to add an eleventh.
findings.why: The official pop-ups are unbounded (rules/forms/1707-v2021/README.md:3), and read_inputs rebuilds each schedule from the ten visible rows (form_1707_view.rs:608-653), so a longer schedule cannot be filed from this page and any stored row past ten is dropped on the next edit.

options.name: Add and remove rows
options.detail: Let the user add rows past ten and delete blank ones, as the official pop-up does.

options.name: More pop-up
options.detail: Keep rows A to D on the page and open a pop-up for the rest, mirroring the official OTHERS list.

findings.field: Schedule 2 — Description of shares of stock
findings.now: Row labels run A, B, C, D, D.2 through D.7, so D.1 never appears.
findings.why: The model writes the fourth row as the first official pop-up entry (form_1707.rs:696-700, numbered from index 3), so the entry the official numbers D.1 is labelled 'D'.

options.name: Label row four D.1
options.detail: Show D.1 for the fourth row and continue D.2 to D.7, matching the official pop-up numbering.

options.name: Separate summary row
options.detail: Keep 'D' as the read-only OTHERS total and start the editable pop-up rows at D.1 below it.

findings.now: Errors appear only in the 'Needs review' list below all sections, and the disabled Queue button gives no reason.
findings.why: A failing caption turns red, but the message sits at the bottom of a long page, so the user has to scroll to learn which item blocks queueing (event_form_kit.rs:608-612, 771, 833, 883-885).
